title: Require Service Module Isolation
forbids: service-root acquisition of module internals outside contract, router, and type-only context ports; module acquisition of a sibling module; module.ts acquisition outside root impl; contract leaves outside root base, schema, and their own module; or router leaves outside their module boundary
why: A module is one isolated contract-to-handler capability. Root files compose only its public contract and router faces or declare type-only ports; module implementation descends through the configured service branch and does not reach sideways into sibling implementations.
remediate: Use only module contract indexes from root contract.ts, module router indexes from root router.ts, and type-only module ports from context.ts. Keep module.ts on ../../impl, contract leaves on ../../../base and ../../../schema plus local module owners, router leaves on ../module plus local owners, and remove sibling-module edges.
message: Service modules may communicate only through their declared root composition faces.
